title: Lay on Hands
lines: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health and restores 550 of their mana. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.

title: Power Word: Shield
lines: Draws on the soul of the party member to shield them, absorbing 928 damage. Lasts 30 sec. While the shield holds, spellcasting will not be interrupted by damage. Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec.

lines: Bite the target, dealing 100% normal damage plus 77 and generating a high amount of threat.

title: Wild Growth
lines: Heals the target and their party for 679 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yds of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

title: Riptide
lines: Heals a friendly target for 799 to 883, an additional 805 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.

title: Holy Shield
lines: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 221 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.

title: Prayer of Mending
lines: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 413 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

title: Swift Judgement
lines: Finishes the remaining cooldown on your Judgement ability and reduces the Mana cost of your next Judgement by 100%.

title: Templar's Bulwark
lines: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.

title: Penance
lines: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 92 Holy damage to an enemy, or 425 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

title: Oath of Light
lines: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 5 min, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 400, your Flash of Light by up to 115, and your Holy Shock by up to 230. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.

title: Nature's Swiftness
lines: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

title: Swiftmend
lines: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.

title: Flash of Light
lines: Heals a friendly target for 292 to 325.

title: Seal of Fury
lines: Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 35 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.
Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 168 to 182 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.

title: Barkskin
lines: Your skin becomes as tough as bark. Physical damage taken is reduced by 20%. While you are protected, damaging attacks will not cause spellcasting delays. Lasts 15 sec.

title: Frenzied Regeneration
lines: Converts up to 10 Rage per second into health for 10 sec. Each point of Rage is converted into 1% health.

title: Shield Slam
